items.requirement: `npm ci` installs from the lockfile
`npm run lint` reports no errors
`npm run format:check` passes
`npm run typecheck` passes in strict mode
`npm test` passes
`npm run build` produces a production build
PWA icons match the committed generator's output
The manifest and the worker validate
The offline copy claims only what the offline experience does
Every response is governed by one declared security policy
No permanent product exclusion is present in the shipped sources
The deployable shape is what a free-tier single application needs
Export, reset, and import round-trip the listener's data
The backup format is documented, and the document matches the code it describes
Contrast, names, keyboard reachability, and loading are within the stated targets
The critical flows work in a real browser against a production build
The flows also pass in a second browser engine
items.detail: only one browser engine is installed here (edge); a second-engine run needs a second engine

items.requirement: Vercel production build passes
items.detail: needs Vercel account credentials, which this project does not have or want
items.reason: needs Vercel account credentials, which this project does not have or want
steps: Import the repository into Vercel with `frontend/` as the project root.
Accept the auto-detected Next.js preset; add no environment variables.
Confirm the build log reports Node 26, matching `package.json` `engines.node`.
Follow the five verification steps in `frontend/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.

items.requirement: `frontend/docs/DESIGN.md` visual audit passed
items.detail: proportion and visual hierarchy are judgements no check in this repository makes
items.reason: proportion and visual hierarchy are judgements no check in this repository makes
steps: Open each surface named in DESIGN.md at 1280x900 and at 390x844.
Compare against the layout, spacing, typography, and colour the document specifies.
The automated contrast, naming, and keyboard audits cover what can be computed;
proportion, hierarchy, and visual rhythm are a human judgement and are not asserted.

items.requirement: Firefox desktop, standard web mode
items.detail: the automation protocol this project uses is a Chromium protocol
items.reason: the automation protocol this project uses is a Chromium protocol
steps: Open the production build in Firefox desktop.
Walk the critical flows: first launch, search and play, navigate while playing,
like, queue, playlist edit, reload and session restore, offline shell.
Watch for layout differences at 1280x900 and 390x844, and for focus visibility.

items.requirement: Android Chromium/PWA where available
items.detail: no Android device or emulator is available in this environment
items.reason: no Android device or emulator is available in this environment
steps: Open the deployed origin in Chrome for Android and install it from the menu.
Confirm the installed copy launches standalone and registers a service worker.
Repeat the critical flows offline with the network disabled.

items.requirement: iOS Safari/Home Screen PWA where available
items.detail: no iOS device or simulator is available in this environment
items.reason: no iOS device or simulator is available in this environment
steps: Open the deployed origin in Safari on iOS and add it to the Home Screen.
Confirm it launches standalone, plays, and survives a background/foreground cycle.
Note: iOS is the platform where a waiting service worker is least likely to activate
promptly, so the update notice in M13's flow is the thing to watch.

items.requirement: `ROADMAP.md` reflects actual scope and status
items.detail: checked by hand at each lifecycle stage; the orchestrator owns this file
items.reason: checked by hand at each lifecycle stage; the orchestrator owns this file
steps: Compare the status table against `openspec/changes/archive` and the merge history.
Confirm every DONE milestone has its change archived and its specs synced.

items.requirement: Attribution notices are included for substantial Lyrix-derived code
items.detail: a provenance judgement about authorship, not something a check can decide
items.reason: a provenance judgement about authorship, not something a check can decide
steps: Read `ATTRIBUTION.md` and confirm its claim matches the repository's history:
concepts were studied and reimplemented, and no Lyrix source was copied.
If code is ever copied or modified rather than reimplemented, add its MIT notice.
